d:
Desperate because his wallet carrying his grandfather’s only photograph was stolen, Jethalal rushes home after Tapu calls him. Tapu attempts to redraw the picture on a computer, but Jethalal refuses to cheat and tearfully confesses the truth to Champakkal (Bapu Ji).
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
